text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the exhibition race, we get
to watch Tannhauser run.
Afterward...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think that's basically how things
went. That's why at this
point...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Tannhauseeer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah—Kita, Sato! You came to watch me!
Sorry, I really flubbed it
big-time, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Tannhauser,
you were sooooo...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
On the final stretch, when Rice was
sprinting after the front runner
Bourbon,
you were hot on their heels and steadily
closing the gap.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But it wasn't working! You couldn't quite
reach them! With just 200
meters to the
finish line, you could've changed strategies
and
protected your third place position.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But you never gave up. Even though you
knew you wouldn't catch
them, you still
gave everything you had until the very
end.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but that's why I didn't notice the
racer coming up from behind.
And where'd
it get me? Fourth place. Haha, I really
don't have a good
endgame.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, you had some sort of strategy, right?
You tried to speed up
despite knowing the
risk.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Nah, that wasn't a strategy. I was just
trying to win the race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that what all racers do? There's no
point if we don't aim to win, is
there?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But I guess a loser like me shouldn't be
handing out advice, huh?
Haha... I knew
just trying wouldn't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've got to keep pushing myself nonstop to
get better, just like Teio
and McQueen do.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Which means I gotta train more. Let's see, I guess starting from tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa! My notebook!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll grab it for you! ...Oh, wow! The level of
detail in these notes is
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah—this is the book you carry everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Special Pre-Race Training Routine," "Early
Morning Running
Checklist," "Ikuno's
Recommended Gym Regimen by Muscle
Group"...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at all the routines and
schedules! And you've written
"Gotta work
hard!" so many times...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aah, don't read that! It's just a bunch of
embarrassing scribbles...
Urgh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You haven't been doing all of these
routines, have you? Every day?
Even with
all that community service?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Is that weird? I thought it was a pretty
normal amount of work...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is a normal amount?! I'm no expert, but this feels like way too much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm pretty sure I need to increase my
weight training. Hmm, I'll
have to
rearrange some things... My schedule's
always so packed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any secret weapons or special
skills. If I want to win
against those
monster racers, there's only one option.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've just gotta work as hard as I can. Push
myself more and more... so I
can live up to
the expectations of everyone supporting
me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser was so amazing on the track,
but she still doesn't consider
herself
special.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's what being at this school
does to you. Tannhauser was
definitely
amazing, but there are even stronger
racers...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone here is on a whole other
level. I knew that'd be the
case, but still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, we're all here! Wanna get started?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh? Something's happening over there...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's get this strategy sesh rolling!
Us ex-convicts gotta make
our grand
comeback!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Woo, ex-comics! Wait, what's that?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm just saying our community service is
finally over, yeah? We
seriously worked
our butts off—headpats all around!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: We brought it on ourselves, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Now that we have more free time, it would
be nice if we could work
together to
improve our skills.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I think we all know we're not exactly
Tracen's best and brightest. But
different
perspectives might help us change that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I agree. If you recall, I was trying to
organize a joint training session in
the first
place. But somehow we got off track...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Seriously, how did we get dragged into this? We always seem to draw the short straw when we're with you guys.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? You're not coming, Nature? But I
wanted to run with you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... This was all your fault in the first
place... Also, I didn't say I
wouldn't do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. All right then, let's kick off the
meeting! For victory!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They're so focused all of a sudden. I feel
like I barely know them...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
They're all serious about getting first
place. I guess at Tracen, that's a
normal
thing, huh.
